lede: The biggest thing this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where the Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA comes up for a vote — that's the cost-sharing extension for the 2027 gondola replacement planning budget, the project built on the SMART 3A funding voters backed. Council also takes first readings on two ordinances, including one amending the Telluride Energy Mitigation Program. Meanwhile, the Gondola Advisory Committee meets Monday to hear where things stand with the federal FTA Capital Investment Program funding pipeline.
